title: Top 20 Words
description: Master the most frequent English words.

exercises.text: the the the of of of and and and a a a to to to
in in in is is is you you you that that that it it it
he he he was was was for for for on on on are are are
as as as with with with his his his they they they
the of and a to in is you that it he was for on are

reviewMaterial: These words make up a large percentage of English text.

title: Question Words
description: Practice who, what, when, where, why, how.

exercises.text: who who who what what what when when when
where where where why why why how how how
who is it what is it when is it
where are you why are you how are you
who what when where why how who what when

reviewMaterial: Question words appear constantly in conversation and writing.

title: Action Verbs
description: Common action verbs for everyday typing.

exercises.text: make make make take take take come come come
know know know think think think look look look
want want want give give give use use use
find find find tell tell tell ask ask ask
work work work seem seem seem feel feel feel

reviewMaterial: Verbs drive sentences. Type them smoothly.

title: Time Words
description: Words related to time and sequence.

exercises.text: now now now then then then today today today
year year year day day day week week week
month month month hour hour hour minute minute
before before after after during during
always always never never often often sometimes

reviewMaterial: Time expressions help structure longer text.

title: Place and Direction

exercises.text: here here here there there there where where
home home home school school school work work
left left left right right right up up down down
inside inside outside outside around around
near near near far far far above above below below

reviewMaterial: Spatial words are short and frequent.

title: People and Pronouns

exercises.text: i i i you you you he he he she she she
we we we they they they me me me him him him
her her her us us us them them them
person person people people man man woman woman
child child children children friend friend family

reviewMaterial: Pronouns are among the highest-frequency words.

title: Describing Words

exercises.text: good good good bad bad bad big big big small small
new new new old old old young young young
long long long short short short high high low low
early early late late fast fast slow slow
very very very much much more more most most

reviewMaterial: Adjectives add detail. Keep rhythm steady.

title: Connecting Words

exercises.text: and and and but but but or or or so so so
because because because if if if when when when
although although while while since since
however however therefore therefore moreover
also also also then then then next next finally

reviewMaterial: Connectors link ideas. Practice smooth transitions.

title: Business Basics
description: Words useful in office and professional typing.

exercises.text: meeting meeting meeting report report report
email email email project project project
client client client office office office
schedule schedule schedule deadline deadline
team team team manager manager manager

reviewMaterial: Professional vocabulary builds workplace typing confidence.

title: Mixed High-Frequency
description: A mixed set of the most useful common words.

exercises.text: about about about would would would could could
should should should their their their there there
which which which these these these those those
other other other into into into over over
only only only just just just also also also

reviewMaterial: These words appear in almost every paragraph.

title: Word Pairs

exercises.text: of the of the of the in the in the in the
to the to the to the on the on the on the
for the for the for the at the at the
and the and the and the with the with the
from the from the from the by the by the

reviewMaterial: Preposition + the is an extremely common pattern.

title: Three-Word Phrases
description: Short phrases that appear in natural writing.

exercises.text: one of the one of the one of the
as well as as well as as well as
in order to in order to in order to
a lot of a lot of a lot of
at the same at the same at the same

title: Longer Word Practice
description: Words with more letters and mixed patterns.

exercises.text: important important important different different
available available available necessary necessary
development development development information
experience experience experience education education
government government government environment

reviewMaterial: Longer words train sustained finger sequences.

title: Word Flow Drill
description: Continuous word streams for rhythm and accuracy.

exercises.text: the time has come for people to work together
she will take the next train from the station
they want to know more about the new project
we should look at every option before we decide
you can always ask for help when you need it

reviewMaterial: Flow practice bridges words and full sentences.

title: Common Words Review
description: Review of high-frequency words before sentence training.

exercises.text: the and of to a in is that it for you he was on are
as with his they at be this from or one had by word
but not what all were when we your can said there
use each which she do how their if will up other about
out many then them these so some her would make like

reviewMaterial: Strong word mastery makes sentence typing much easier.
